# CopyManga (拷貝漫畫) fixtures

`series.html`, `catalog-dianjuren.json`, and `reader-dianjuren.html` retain the stripped series page, 320-entry catalog, and 53-page reader from [電鋸人](https://www.copy3000.com/comic/dianjuren).

`contract.json` also retains the catalog and 14-page reader vector from [一拳超人](https://www.copy3000.com/comic/yiquanchaoren) for ordering and unavailable-content cases. Browser tests return controlled raster bytes and exercise both Copy domains with the same series slugs and chapter UUIDs.
